storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Skool Downloader makes it easy to save videos from Skool.com to your computer.

How it works: Go to any Skool classroom, community post, or course module that contains a video. Play the video, then click the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension detects the video -- whether it is hosted on Loom, Vimeo, YouTube, Wistia, or Skool's native player -- shows available quality options, and downloads it as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS streaming, Loom GraphQL extraction, Vimeo configuration parsing, YouTube format extraction, and Wistia embed detection automatically. No external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos download directly to your computer.

Key features:
- Automatic multi-platform video detection (Skool native, Loom, Vimeo, YouTube, Wistia)
- Downloads from Skool classrooms, community posts, about pages, and course modules
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Concurrent download queue with real-time progress and speed indicators
- Dark-themed UI with warm red accents matching Skool's aesthetic
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Skool.com and open a classroom, post, or course module with a video
3. Play the video, then click the extension icon
4. Select quality and download -- saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video from Skool?
faq.answer: Open any Skool classroom, community post, or course page with a video. Press play on the video, then click the SERP Skool Downloader icon in your toolbar. Select your preferred quality and click Download.

faq.question: What video platforms does this support?
faq.answer: The extension detects videos from Skool's native player (Mux-based), Loom, Vimeo, YouTube, and Wistia -- all of which are commonly used within Skool communities and courses.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: Quality options depend on the video platform and source. The extension shows all available resolutions from the original video.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Can I download videos from Skool courses I have purchased?
faq.answer: Yes. If you have access to a Skool classroom or course and can play the video in your browser, the extension can detect and download it.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes -- supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Press play on the video first. The extension needs the stream to start before detection works. If the video is embedded from an external platform, make sure the embed has loaded fully. Refresh the page if issues persist.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP -- no passwords stored. No video data is sent to external servers.

faq.question: Does this work with password-protected Skool communities?
faq.answer: The extension works with any Skool community or course you can access in your browser. If you can see and play the video, you can download it.
